privacy.title: TODO: Privacy
privacy.intro: TODO: {brand} plans suppers around your budget. Here is what we keep and why, in plain language.
privacy.location: TODO: Location: we only keep your area to about 100 metres, to find shops near you. We never track where you go.
privacy.household: TODO: Your plan: the number of people, your budget and the foods you avoid, so we can plan suppers.
privacy.receipts: TODO: Receipts: only if you choose to scan one. We read the products and prices, remove card numbers, names and phone numbers, and delete the photo after 30 days.
privacy.push: TODO: Reminders: only if you allow them. You can switch each kind off in Settings.
privacy.noAds: TODO: No adverts, no ad trackers, and we never sell your data.
privacy.rights: TODO: You can download or delete your data any time in Settings → Data & privacy.
privacy.contact: TODO: Questions about your data: contact us using the email in the app store listing.
